AMENDED TO BE TYPE 1 ZONING MAP AMENDMENT
3657 W 31st Street / 3101-11 S Lawndale Avenue
Rezone from RS3 to B3-2

October 5, 2023

1A. Narrative Analysis

Little Village Environmental Justice Organization (LVEJO) purchased 3657 W 31st Street,
Chicago, IL 60623 (PIN: 16-35-106-001-0000) in 2022. The existing 5,723 sf parcel contains
two structures: one 1,880 sf single-story commercial brick building (IIIB) to remain and one
two-story wood framed (VB) residential carriage house N.I.C. The brick building contained
two separate retail businesses under a variance from the current RS-3 zoning.

B3-2 Zoning change is requested to facilitate a shared commercial kitchen in addition to
confirming a longstanding variance for commercial use. LVEJO will occupy the building,
renovating the two existing connected commercial spaces for use as their office and
meeting rooms with attached shared commercial kitchen to support ongoing farm and food
programs benefitting the local community. Two parking spaces will be provided, one ADA
space and one regular parking space.
